project_name: EFCIS LMS - Easy Finance Credit Investigation Services Loan Management System
design_philosophy: Modern Dashboard style. Professional, clean, structured feel. Focuses on data digestibility with minimal cognitive load. Employs a 'Control Room' grid layout.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Tailwind scale heavily utilized for visual hierarchy.
spacing_and_layout.grid_classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

authentication_page.layout: Centered card layout. The background should feature the subtle architectural image with a glassmorphism overlay.
authentication_page.card: bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 shadow-xl rounded-2xl p-8 max-w-md w-full
authentication_page.logo: 2x2 inch equivalent (w-16 h-16) centered at the top
authentication_page.header: System Name (EFCIS LMS) below logo, bold and clean
authentication_page.form: Email and password inputs, large primary gradient login button
authentication_page.footer: System developer (Darwin IT Dev) at the bottom, small and muted

top_header.right: System Time/Date, User Avatar dropdown (Logout on click)

tables.style: Clean, minimal borders. Zebra striping optional but hover states on rows are mandatory.
tables.header: Sticky header, bg-slate-50, text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 font-bold

multi_step_modal.layout: Mobile-first stacked layout, max-w-3xl on desktop
multi_step_modal.progress_indicator: Numbered steps or visual progress bar at the top
multi_step_modal.animations: Framer motion fade-in/slide-up for step transitions
multi_step_modal.photo_capture: Integration for rear camera + geolocation overlay (mocked UI block showing camera feed frame and map pin)

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-green-600 to-green-500 text-white font-semibold rounded-lg px-4 py-2 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-green-500/30 transition-all duration-200
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all duration-200
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-all duration-200

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must have a visible hover state (bg color change or subtle transform).
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Use 'transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out' globally for standard interactions.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 2 for clear, legible iconography. Active sidebar icons use stroke-green-600.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio against backgrounds.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include 'data-testid' (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='sidebar-loan-app').

images.description: Abstract minimal architectural background in pale green and white. Used as full-screen background on the authentication page.
images.usage_instructions: Set as absolute positioned background with object-cover on the Auth page. Overlay the login card on top.
Crop to 1:1 aspect ratio, apply rounded-xl or full circle. Render at w-16 h-16 (2x2 inch) on login and w-8 h-8 on sidebar header.

images.description: Professional headshot portrait for the logged-in user.
images.usage_instructions: Use in the top header right section. Apply rounded-full, w-10 h-10, object-cover.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Tailwind config with the custom colors (slate and green families).
Use Lucide-React for all icons. Ensure `data-testid` is applied rigorously.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF for backgrounds without context. Base background is #F9FAFB.
Build the 8-step modal using standard React state or context. Mobile view must stack cleanly.
Implement Shadcn UI components but strip excessive Vercel-like styling to match this organic/swiss hybrid look.
Mock the camera integration block as a styled UI placeholder for the 8-step wizard.
